themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, conduct analysis, and make decisions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers articles about new and existing AI tools specifically designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and reviewing code.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the research, development, and user interaction with AI-powered chatbots, including their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focused on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, hiring practices, required skills, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in the design process, including generative design, UI/UX design assistance, and design system integration.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated user personas or simulations for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, or guide users on selecting and utilizing various AI tools.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is applied to understand market needs, develop new products, and improve existing ones.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
